name: 役割とメンバーの権限管理パネル
prompt:
Create the second render of the same Japanese conversation-permissions panel. Use the native 390x670 preview as the exact authority for geometry and all existing Japanese content; use v001 only as the correction target. Preserve the added source hyperlink 「編集」 at the top-right: it must remain blue (#5865F2 family), because it represents the blue “Edit” hyperlink visible in the selected source crop and the user explicitly requires link text to be blue. No other text is a hyperlink; keep buttons, tabs, add actions and selectable rows in their native dark/green/gray colors.

Keep the exact 390x670 canvas and all exact labels: 「会話の権限」「編集」「基本表示」「詳細表示」「この権限は分類「交流の会話」と同期していません。」「今すぐ同期」「新しい権限」「役割を追加」「メンバーを追加」「役割」「全員」「メンバー」「山田 はるか」「やまだ・はるか」. Keep 「詳細表示」 selected, with the same colors and glyphs as the native preview.

Correct the vertical drift from v001. Its notice and sync action are about 9-10px too low; the lower sections drift progressively to about 10-20px too low. Place the notice at the native y127. Set the pale-mint sync action to x16,y163,w358,h58. Place 「新しい権限」 at the native y261, first add row at its native y313 with the divider near y344, second row at its native y374 with divider near y403. Place 「役割」 around y440, its 「全員」 row around y488 and divider near y520. Place 「メンバー」 around y557. Keep later content from accumulating downward drift and leave the native bottom whitespace.

In the member row, make the mint 「山」 avatar 40x40 at x24,y589, the name/subtitle column x80 with name near y590 and subtitle near y618, and keep the gray chevron at x360 around y608. Shift the add and role row text slightly right as in the native preview. Keep the centered title and blue link aligned on the top row. Do not change the copy, add content, tint action labels blue, or introduce card styling or shadows.
reviewNotes: a002: 「編集」 blue; residual vertical drift 8-9px and member avatar/column offset after bounded two attempts.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
